CalculatedInsight.description: Rolling 60-second aggregation over LiveEvents__dlm. Surfaces current xG, shots-on-target, and event counts per match for the second-screen UI.
CalculatedInsight.label: Live Match Snapshot
CalculatedInsight.sqlExpression: SELECT match_id__c, fixture_label__c, COUNT(*) AS events__c, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type__c = 'Shot' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shots__c, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type__c = 'Goal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goals__c, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type__c = 'Yellow Card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yellow_cards__c, MAX(received_at__c) AS last_event_at__c FROM LiveEvents__dlm WHERE received_at__c > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '60' MINUTE GROUP BY match_id__c, fixture_label__c
